caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with two doors, standing on two large round feet at the front and two short block feet at the back. The cabinet is shown at a slight angle to display both the front and the right side. The surface of the cabinet doors features intricate, symmetrical decorative carvings or painted designs that include clusters of fruit, such as pears and round fruits, possibly apples or oranges, along with ornate leafy patterns and ribbons at the top. The overall color palette consists of muted, natural tones such as browns for the wood, with the carvings or painted embossments highlighted in shades of grey, white, and hints of green. The background is plain and off-white, drawing full attention to the cabinet and its detailed design. The cabinet's top and side edges are accentuated by dark brown lines, giving definition to its structure.
